description: List trending AI research papers from Hugging Face Papers by period: daily (默认, 每日) | weekly (每周) | monthly (每月). Returns ranked papers with title, url, abstract, authors, publication date, upvotes, GitHub repo with stars (if any), arXiv link, organization, comment count, and submitter. Requires browser (Chrome/Edge with remote debugging); no login required.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Trending period: daily (default, 每日) | weekly (每周) | monthly (每月). All accepted values: daily, weekly, monthly. Invalid values return INVALID_PARAM.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum papers to return, integer between 1 and 100 (default 20). Daily lists are capped at 30 papers total; the actual returned count is reported when limit exceeds available papers.
